title: How hard is the GTA 6 Platinum trophy?
yt_title: How hard is the GTA 6 Platinum? 🏆 55 trophies explained
description: How hard is the GTA 6 Platinum? GTA 6 has 55 trophies on PS5: 46 bronze, 6 silver, 2 gold and 1 platinum, and the same 55 achievements worth 1,000 Gamerscore on Xbox. Every one is single-player, and the Platinum needs all the others (GGRecon). Guides reportedly say 28 are hidden, mostly story ones, and PowerPyx estimates about 200 hours for the Platinum, more than double the 45 to 80 hours of the story, while rating the difficulty just 4 out of 10 (unofficial). No spoilers. Is it worth the grind? Will you go for it? Comment below.
rumor_note: Rumor (guides only): 28 hidden trophies and a ~200-hour Platinum estimate (PowerPyx).
